about: Crafting, as the OSRS Wiki's item pages give it (read 2026-10-30). spinning: what a spinning wheel spins, in the Make-X box's order, with the level and XP in tenths; 3 ticks each (Ball of wool and Bow string pages), the first 2 ticks after the choice inferred from fletching's 'Make-X is 2, then 3 ticks'. The wheels are every loc the cache names Spinning wheel with a Spin option. anim 466 is the cache's 'spinningwheel' seq, taken to be the player's (inferred from the name; the wheels have no animation of their own). leather: a needle on leather, hard leather or dragon leather opens the Make-X box over what it makes, with how many leathers each takes (Leather, Hardleather body, Green dragon leather and the d'hide pages); thread is held and one is used up every 5 items (Thread: 'Each thread spool has 5 uses before it is consumed'). 3 ticks an item, hard leather 2 (each item's page); the first 2 ticks after the choice is inferred as for spinning. The Wiki gives leather boots 16.3 XP (16.25 elsewhere): 163 tenths. anim 1249 is human_leather_crafting. studs: steel studs on a leather body or chaps, 3 ticks (Studded body). Out: d'hide shields (they need a maple shield and nails), snakeskin, spiky vambraces and the costume needle. Ids are the 241 cache's; names are its gamevals.
